Author: Valentina Vieri
Name: VieriRotationHelper
Punchline: Wrath-parity rotation suggestions for every combat job.
Description: Displays independent single-target, AoE, and target-aware dynamic rotation suggestion bars for every supported combat job. Includes positional cues, enemy counts, range feedback, cooldowns, and GCD timing based on the authorized Hilda display reference. When Wrath Combo is loaded, lead suggestions are read from Wrath's exact live action replacements. This plugin never executes actions.
